kdcdefaults.description: Global KDC default settings for listening ports.

kdc_ports.description: List of UDP ports on which the KDC listens for Kerberos requests.

kdc_tcp_ports.description: List of TCP ports on which the KDC listens for Kerberos requests (used for large tickets or referrals).

realms.description: List of Kerberos realms managed by this KDC.

name.description: The canonical uppercase Kerberos realm name (e.g., 'ATHENA.MIT.EDU').

database_name.description: Path to the KDC database file (main principal store).

admin_keytab.description: Path to the keytab file containing the admin server principal keys.

acl_file.description: Path to the ACL file that defines administrative access control for this realm.

key_stash_file.description: Path to the stash file (encrypted master key storage).

kdc_ports.description: List of UDP ports on which this realm's KDC listens (overrides kdcdefaults).

max_renewable_life.description: Maximum renewable lifetime of a ticket.

master_key_type.description: Encryption type used for the master key (must match stash file).

supported_enctypes.description: Colon-separated list of encryption types supported for this realm (order matters: strongest first).

extra_params.description: Additional custom KDC parameters not covered above (key-value pairs).

logging.description: Logging destination configuration for KDC, admin server, and general Kerberos library messages.

kdc.description: Log destination for KDC events (e.g., FILE: or SYSLOG: with optional level, e.g., 'FILE:/path INFO').

admin_server.description: Log destination for admin server operations (kadmin).

default.description: General Kerberos library log destination (e.g., authentication failures).
